note: Targets for the L0 locomotion scorecard (tools/loco/summary.py). Gorilla numbers are eyeballed from the side-view frames of the owner's reference clip (kept outside the repo); replace them with a keypoint measurement. Metric paths use dots: foot_slip_cm.p95.

head_pitch_deg.mean.source: estimate from frames 2026-11-21, replace with keypoint measurement

shoulder_hip_ratio.source: estimate from frames 2026-11-21, replace with keypoint measurement

back_slope_deg.source: estimate from frames 2026-11-21, replace with keypoint measurement; positive = shoulders higher, back slopes down to the hips

torso_roll_deg.source: estimate from frames 2026-11-21 (7 deg), replace with keypoint measurement; tolerance tightened from the brief's 4 to 3 so a 3 deg rigid torso fails

roll_plant_lag.source: estimate from frames 2026-11-21: roll peaks near the front hand plant (0 = at touchdown, fraction of the stride cycle)

torso_bob_frac.source: estimate from frames 2026-11-21: bob about 4% of shoulder height

foot_slip_cm.p95.source: estimate from frames 2026-11-21: planted hands do not slide

universal.source: M1 limp brief: starting value, paired left/right footfall root drop and planted-side roll max/min; validate by owner before/after clip. Gallop leads and terrain compensation can be asymmetric.
owner movement canon 2026-11-21: legs never bend the wrong way (knee against its rest bend direction on any stance leg)
owner movement canon 2026-11-21: feet and knees do not go through the ground (p95 depth under 1 cm)
brief loco-score: foot slip p95 under 3 cm
brief loco-score: head pitch within +-12 deg (climb is excluded: the ground itself is tilted)
brief loco-score: pivot_frac under 0.05 while moving
starting value: at most 15% of the turning frames are pivots; checked by the turn scenario (a U-turn is mostly pivot today)
brief loco-score: stall_frac = 0 on steps (stalled state or a go order that has stopped the body)
brief loco-score: a gallop has a flight phase; applied to bodies with 4 legs or fewer (many-legged bodies keep a foot down by design)
brief loco-score: no flight phase in a walk
starting value (hip-to-ankle over leg length of a stance leg; real walkers stay near 0.9); calibrate against the Muybridge sheets, catches crouched legs
starting value: neighbouring same-side feet at least 0.3 leg lengths apart; catches bunched centipede legs
starting value: the head stays within 30 deg of the body heading (periscope neck guard)
starting value: on slopes steeper than 0.1 the body tilts at least 60% of the slope
starting value: the back slope on a climb differs from the walk's by at least 5 deg (derived: |back_slope climb - back_slope walk|)
